reason: The tricks sound fun for the kids, but an 'app' I install from a website and pay for by card on that same site feels like exactly the kind of thing my WhatsApp groups warn about. I might try the free tricks, but I'm not typing my card into an unknown site for 99 ₪.
objection: It's not in the App Store or Google Play, so who stands behind it? Paying by card on a website I've never heard of, for something that wants to get into my gallery, notes and calls, sounds like a scam or a privacy risk.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay through the App Store or Google Play (or at least Bit/PayPal with a refund guarantee), plus a friend in one of my groups showing me it really works.
